item.title: Understanding Psalm 82 and Michael Heiser’s Divine Council Theology
item.description: Justin Peters examines Psalm 82 and critiques Divine Council theology, offering a biblical response to Michael Heiser’s influence in evangelicalism.

item.description: How should Christians prepare for Christmas? This episode of Equipping You in Grace offers eight biblical reflections on the incarnation, worship, peace, joy, and the humility of Christ.

item.title: Leading with Love During the Holidays
item.description: In this episode of Warriors of Grace, Dave Jenkins calls Christian men to lead with Christlike love during the holidays, drawing from Colossians 3:12–14 and John 13:34–35. The episode addresses holiday stress, family tensions, and practical ways men can reflect the love of Christ at home and in the church.
